column1: # Real freewebnovel.com pages, unedited, captured through the dev Worker
# (tools/README.md) — this host answers a direct fetch with a 403 interstitial
# on the very first request, so there is no direct route to it at all.
# capture_url and app_url are the same.
# columns: site  file  capture_url  app_url  kind  completed  chapters  max_page
# `chapters` is the DISTINCT chapter links inside .m-newest2 — NOT .m-newest1,
# which is a six-link "latest chapters" widget present on all 100 pages — and
# `max_page` is the NUMBER OF OPTIONS in #indexselect, which is the only place
# the page states how long the listing is: every option's value is page 1 and
# no "?page=" link appears anywhere. Both measured with bs4/lxml, never with
# The 100 are 44 finished and 56 ongoing, across listings of 1 page to 181
# (40 chapters a page, so a handful of chapters up to ~7,200).
